findings.summary: crates/setup/tests/cluster.rs:reads_the_secret_by_key_names_only checks only that `rollout status` has some --timeout, not that it is 2m. Changing --timeout=2m to --timeout=5m in crates/setup/src/lib.rs still passed every test, so AC-4's 2-minute limit is not pinned by a test.

crates/setup/src/lib.rs check_sign_in reads `kubectl logs deployment/sdlc-board`, which picks one pod. Right after a rollout on a real cluster it could pick the old pod while that pod is still terminating, giving a false back-out. This needs the live Outcome check.

`board-setup key --app-id ""` with a valid key exits 1 with 'GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY is set but GITHUB_APP_ID isn't', which is the server's wording, not the CLI's. It changes nothing on the cluster, but the message is misleading for an empty --app-id.
